summary: NET Power Inc. operates as an energy technology company in the United States. Its technology includes oxy-combustion cycle, a power generation system designed to produce electricity from natural gas while capturing atmospheric emissions. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Durham, North Carolina.
